reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet I can carry around solves a problem I don't have. I'm not going to switch a routine that works for a pricier box.
objection: I already have a bottle of magnesium at home and pay less per day, and I never take it on the go. Paying for the travel format means paying extra for something I won't use.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a real moment where I would need it away from home, like travel or a late night out, plus a price close to what my current bottle costs per day.
